name: Cluster weak lensing (shapes and NFW mass)
description: Tangential shear of one cluster and an NFW mass. The shape step measures a metacalibration response on stamps with one round Gaussian PSF and a per-object diagonal response, including a selection response for a resolution or ellipticity cut. Completing that step does not complete a survey calibration. The mass step bins the tangential shear and fits a spherical NFW halo. The stack step averages shear catalogues on a common radius and fits that average. It does not accept an image stack. The two-halo spectrum defaults to Takahashi et al. 2012 Halofit. The fit covariance can include large-scale structure or an azimuthal jackknife. This is not the strong-lens model.

params.name: x-column
params.label: X column (1-based pixels)
params.help: Pixel column for the shape step and for an xy mass. Catalogue positions are 1-based.

params.name: coord
params.label: Mass coordinates
params.help: xy uses the pixel columns, the centre and the pixel scale. sky uses RA and Dec. East is to the left.

params.name: center-x
params.label: Centre X (pixel, 1-based)
params.help: Required for coord xy. 0 is unset.

params.name: center-y
params.label: Centre Y (pixel, 1-based)
params.help: Required for coord xy. 0 is unset.

params.name: pixel-scale
params.label: Pixel scale (arcsec/pixel)
params.help: Required for coord xy. 0 is unset. The tool does not invent a telescope scale.

params.name: ra-column
params.label: RA column (degrees)
params.help: Used when coord is sky.

params.name: ra
params.label: Cluster RA (degrees)
params.help: Used when coord is sky. 0 can be a real right ascension.

params.name: dec
params.label: Cluster Dec (degrees)
params.help: Used when coord is sky.

params.name: psf-fwhm
params.label: PSF FWHM (pixels, 0 = none)
params.help: Round Gaussian PSF for the shape step. 0 measures the stamp with no PSF model.

params.name: stamp
params.label: Stamp width (pixels)
params.help: The cut is made odd so the object sits on the centre pixel.

params.name: dg
params.label: Metacalibration shear step
params.help: Finite difference used for the shear response and, when a cut is set, the selection response.

params.name: min-resolution
params.label: Minimum resolution (0 = off)
params.help: Resolution is 1 - T_psf/T. 0 applies no resolution cut. The cut enters only the selection response.

params.name: emax
params.label: Maximum |e| (0 = off)
params.help: 0 applies no absolute-ellipticity cut. The cut enters only the selection response. WL_G stays e/R.

params.name: g1-column
params.label: g1 column
params.help: Shear in the tangent plane. g1 > 0 stretches along +x (right).

params.name: w-column
params.label: Weight column
params.help: Empty or missing column uses equal weights. The shape noise is set separately.

params.name: z-column
params.label: Source redshift column
params.help: Used when Source redshift is 0. A positive value in that box overrides the column.

params.name: z-lens
params.label: Cluster redshift
params.help: Required and positive. 0 stops the mass step.

params.name: z-source
params.label: Source redshift (0 = column or n(z))
params.help: One redshift for every source. 0 uses the redshift column, or the n(z) file if that column is empty.

params.name: z-shift
params.label: Source redshift shift
params.help: Added to every source redshift. It is not fitted.

params.name: z-gap
params.label: Minimum z_source - z_lens
params.help: Sources closer than this are dropped.

params.name: nz
params.label: n(z) file (z and n)
params.help: Two columns, redshift and weight. Used only when no per-source redshift is available. Empty is allowed.

params.name: random-catalog
params.label: Random catalogue
params.help: Same coordinates as the sources. The boost is n_src/n_rand, normalised to 1 in the outer bin. Empty means the boost is 1.

params.name: nbins
params.label: Radial bins
params.help: Logarithmic bins from the inner to the outer radius.

params.name: min-per-bin
params.label: Minimum sources per bin
params.help: Bins with fewer sources are left out of the fit.

params.name: gmax
params.label: Maximum |g|
params.help: Sources with a larger component are dropped.

params.name: sigma-e
params.label: Shape noise per component
params.help: Rms of one shear component at weight 1. This is the shape-noise piece. Large-scale structure is a separate switch.

params.name: m-bias
params.label: Multiplicative bias m
params.help: The shear used in the fit is (g - c) / (1 + m).

params.name: concentration
params.label: Concentration
params.help: duffy uses Duffy et al. 2008 Table 1 (NFW, full sample, 200 rho_crit, z=0-2), a WMAP5 calibration. free fits log c. fixed uses the value below.

params.name: c-fixed
params.label: Fixed c_200
params.help: Used when Concentration is fixed.

params.name: reduced
params.label: Reduced shear g = gamma / (1 - kappa)
params.help: Off fits the shear gamma = DeltaSigma / Sigma_crit.

params.name: two-halo
params.label: Two-halo term
params.help: Tinker et al. 2010 bias. The spectrum is the Two-halo spectrum below. Not a Boltzmann code.

params.name: power
params.label: Two-halo spectrum
params.help: halofit is Takahashi et al. 2012 with w = -1 on an Eisenstein and Hu 1998 zero-baryon linear spectrum. linear keeps that spectrum without the nonlinear fit. Full Halofit includes field one-halo power.

params.name: count-slope
params.label: Count slope s (0 = off)
params.help: s = d log10 N(<m) / dm. The model shear is multiplied by 1+(5s-2) kappa. 0.4 is a null test.

params.name: lss-cov
params.label: Large-scale-structure covariance
params.help: Shape noise plus the Gaussian variance of the annulus-averaged tangential shear, for one source plane at the median source redshift. A jackknife replaces this matrix.

params.name: n-jackknife
params.label: Azimuthal jackknife wedges (0 = off)
params.help: Leave-one-wedge-out covariance. When it can be formed it replaces the analytic covariance. 0 leaves it off.

params.name: h0
params.label: H0 (km/s/Mpc)
params.help: Flat LambdaCDM. These are the defaults of the fit, not a Planck result.

params.name: ns
params.label: Scalar spectral index
params.help: Used by the linear spectrum.

params.name: sigma8
params.label: sigma8
params.help: Amplitude of the linear spectrum at 8 Mpc/h.

params.name: miscenter
params.label: Miscentring
params.help: A centred fraction plus a Rayleigh offset. Turn on Fit miscentring to vary them inside the prior widths.

params.name: f-cen
params.label: Centred fraction
params.help: Used only when miscentring is on.

params.name: sigma-off
params.label: Offset scale (Mpc)
params.help: Rayleigh scale of the centre offset, in proper Mpc. This is the prior centre when the offset is fitted.

params.name: fit-miscenter
params.label: Fit miscentring
params.help: Fit the centred fraction and the offset when their prior widths below are positive. The widths are caller inputs, not a calibration.

params.name: f-cen-sigma
params.label: Prior width on centred fraction
params.help: Gaussian prior width. 0 keeps the centred fraction fixed.

params.name: sigma-off-sigma
params.label: Prior width on offset (Mpc)
params.help: Gaussian prior width in proper Mpc. 0 keeps the offset fixed.

params.name: mean-response
params.label: Mean shear response (0 = unused)
params.help: Mean per-object response from the shape step. Used with the selection responses below. 0 applies no selection factor.

params.name: selection-r1
params.label: Selection response R1
params.help: From the shape step. Observed g1 is multiplied by mean_response / (mean_response + R1).

params.name: selection-r2
params.label: Selection response R2
params.help: Same factor for g2.

params.name: galaxy
params.label: Calibration galaxy
params.help: Profile drawn for the internal m and c. This is not a survey calibration.

params.name: sersic-n
params.label: Sersic index
params.help: Used when the calibration galaxy is sersic. 1 is an exponential disc.

params.name: mcal-noise
params.label: Calibration noise (0 = none)
params.help: Gaussian noise on the drawn galaxy, in image units. 0 is noiseless.

params.name: samples
params.label: Metropolis samples (0 = least squares)
params.help: The quoted mass is the chain median when this is positive, otherwise the least-squares point. The uncertainty follows the covariance switch.

params.name: clusters
params.label: Cluster shear list (JSON)
params.help: JSON list of shear catalogues. Each catalogue has positions, g1, g2, redshift and weight. A stacked image is not accepted.

params.name: radius
params.label: Stack radius
params.help: mpc uses a common proper distance. r200c divides each profile by the caller R_200c.

params.name: icl-weights-differ
params.label: ICL weights differ from lensing weights
params.help: Record that the ICL average and the lensing average do not represent the same population.
